extracted.intended_audience: undergraduate physics & astronomy students, chapter advisers, and prospective members
extracted.subtask_description: Descriptive informational page about the Society of Physics Students (SPS): who may join, what chapters do, and member benefits (publications, awards, internships, professional development).

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Membership, through collegiate chapters, is open to anyone interested in the physical sciences; besides physics majors, members include majors in astronomy, chemistry, computer science, engineering, and other fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied requirement: interest in the physical sciences; membership typically occurs via an institutional collegiate chapter (individual, discounted group, or chapter membership options are available).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapters as primary unit
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapters are the heart of the SPS experience and connect students to outreach, awards, scholarship opportunities, research, professional development, networking, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each chapter is individualized by member interests, their physics/astronomy departments, and geographical setting; chapters should pursue activities that best serve their members, department, campus, and local community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: SPS helps build skills needed to flourish professionally, including effective communication, leadership experience, networking, research experiences, and outreach services to the campus and local communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chapters and SPS programming should support development in these specific competencies as part of membership value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication opportunity — The SPS Observer
rubrics_metrics.description: The SPS Observer is SPS's flagship publication, published by SPS and AIP three times a year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members can read and contribute to this triannual publication; frequency and publisher partnership are specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities to publish research (JURPA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Members have opportunities to publish research in the Journal of Undergraduate Research in Physics and Astronomy (JURPA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPS provides a member-facing avenue for undergraduate research publication; implies eligibility tied to SPS membership and undergraduate research output.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards, scholarships, and grants offered
rubrics_metrics.description: SPS provides scholarships, research and travel grants, and outreach awards for individuals and chapters in physics and astronomy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statement of available funding/awards types; no application criteria are given on this page, but these are offered to individuals and chapters involved in physics/astronomy activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internship placement program
rubrics_metrics.description: The SPS internship program places undergraduates in organizations that advance physics in policy, outreach, research, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied criterion: undergraduates (members) can access internships through SPS that are oriented toward policy, outreach, and research contexts; logistics/selection details are not provided on this page.
